About Me

I'm a creative, writer, and social media manager based in Nigeria with over 6 years of hands-on experience building online communities, crafting content that converts, and managing digital platforms for faith-based organisations.

From growing a Facebook page from 300 to 772 followers, to co-administering a 96,000-member community, I bring strategy, creativity, and consistency to every platform I manage.

I combine traditional storytelling with modern tools like AI, Meta Ads, CapCut, and Canva to produce content that doesn't just reach people — it moves them.
